title: Transient tertiary structure in intrinsically disordered proteins revealed by multithermal enhanced sampling.
authors: Streit, Julian O; Invernizzi, Michele; Bottaro, Sandro; Tamiola, Kamil; Lindorff-Larsen, Kresten
one_liner_zh: 该文用多热增强采样(OPES)模拟无序蛋白ACTR，揭示其与伙伴结合相关的瞬时三级结构，属于IDP构象机制建模，但未直接研究PPI界面，故评8分。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins populate heterogeneous conformational ensembles that are challenging to characterise. While all-atom molecular dynamics simulations can provide detailed insights into dynamic ensembles, achieving sufficient sampling remains difficult. Here, we show that On-the-fly Probability Enhanced Sampling (OPES) in the multithermal ensemble enables efficient generation of atomistic ensembles for disordered peptides and proteins ranging from 15 to 71 residues in length. OPES achieves multithermal sampling within a single simulation replica, without replica exchange or extensive parameter tuning. Across multiple systems, OPES yields reweighted ensembles broadly consistent with replica-exchange with solute tempering (REST2) and unbiased simulations, while accelerating convergence and enabling broader exploration of low-population conformational states. Applied to the intrinsically disordered transcriptional coactivator ACTR, OPES reveals transiently structured states in which multiple alpha-helices involved in partner binding fold cooperatively and form tertiary contacts. These rare, partially structured conformations are reversibly sampled during the simulations, are consistent with extensive NMR and SAXS data, and could facilitate folding-upon-binding through conformational selection. They may also represent viable targets for drug design or for engineering disordered proteins with customised conformational landscapes. More broadly, our results establish OPES multithermal sampling as a robust and accessible approach for uncovering functionally relevant conformations in intrinsically disordered proteins.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered proteins（内在无序蛋白）会形成异质的构象集合，这对其表征构成挑战。尽管全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟能提供动态集合的详细见解，但实现充分采样仍然困难。在此，我们展示在多热系综（multithermal ensemble）中的On-the-fly Probability Enhanced Sampling (OPES) 方法能够高效生成长度从15到71个残基的无序肽和蛋白质的原子级集合。OPES在单一模拟副本内实现多热采样，无需副本交换或大量参数调整。在多个系统中，OPES产生的重加权集合与副本交换溶质升温法（replica-exchange with solute tempering, REST2）及无偏模拟大体一致，同时加速收敛并促进对低群体构象状态的更广泛探索。应用于内在无序转录共激活因子ACTR时，OPES揭示了瞬态结构化状态，其中多个参与伙伴结合的α-螺旋协同折叠并形成三级接触。这些稀有的部分结构化构象在模拟中被可逆采样，与广泛的NMR和SAXS数据一致，并可能通过构象选择促进结合诱导折叠。它们也可能代表药物设计或工程化具有定制构象景观的无序蛋白的可行靶点。更广泛地说，我们的结果确立了OPES多热采样作为一种稳健且易用的方法，用于揭示内在无序蛋白中功能相关构象。
